observations.body: Paul contrasts food disputes with righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit as the character of God’s Kingdom.
observations.label: Not eating and drinking

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside not eating and drinking.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Romans 14:15–19 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states paul contrasts food disputes with righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit as the character of God’s Kingdom. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Not eating and drinking
